types.name: Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA)
types.purpose: Visit for tourism, family, business or short study without a visa — for nationalities that do not need a visa.
types.who: Nationals who do not need a UK visa
types.note: Not a visa. Up to 6 months per visit.

types.name: Standard Visitor visa
types.purpose: Tourism, visiting family, business meetings, short courses up to 6 months, medical treatment, academic visits.
types.who: Nationals who need a UK visa
types.note: At most 6 months on each visit, even with a long-term visa. You must not live in the UK through frequent visits.

types.name: Marriage Visitor visa
types.purpose: Getting married or registering a civil partnership in the UK (not living there afterwards).
types.who: Anyone

types.name: Permitted Paid Engagement visa
types.purpose: Paid work for up to 1 month by invitation: lectures, examining, performing, sports events, professional services.
types.who: Invited professionals, artists and sportspeople

types.name: Visitor in Transit visa
types.purpose: Passing through UK border control and leaving the UK within 48 hours.
types.who: Nationals who need a transit visa
types.note: You must leave within 48 hours. Staying longer needs a Standard Visitor visa.

types.name: Direct Airside Transit visa
types.purpose: Changing flights without going through UK border control — for nationalities that need it.
types.who: Nationals on the airside-transit list
types.note: Does not allow entry into the UK.

types.name: Student visa
types.purpose: Study a course at a licensed university, college or school (age 16 or over).
types.who: Students aged 16+ with a licensed sponsor
types.maxValidity: Length of the course plus a few months

types.name: Child Student visa
types.purpose: Children aged 4–17 studying at an independent school in the UK.
types.who: Children aged 4–17 at an independent school
types.maxValidity: Length of the course plus a few months

types.name: Short-term study visa (English language)
types.purpose: English language courses of 6 to 11 months.
types.who: Adults on an English language course

types.name: Graduate visa
types.purpose: Stay and work after successfully finishing a UK degree.
types.who: Graduates of a UK degree on a Student visa
types.maxValidity: 2 years (18 months if you apply from 1 January 2027); 3 years after a PhD

types.name: Skilled Worker visa
types.purpose: A job with an approved UK employer (sponsor) at the required skill and salary level; family can join.
types.who: Workers with a job offer from a licensed sponsor
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years, then extend or settle

types.name: Health and Care Worker visa
types.purpose: Doctors, nurses, health and adult social care professionals working for the NHS or approved employers.
types.who: Health and care workers with an eligible employer

types.name: Global Talent visa
types.purpose: Leaders or potential leaders in academia, research, arts and culture or digital technology.
types.who: Endorsed leaders in their field
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years at a time

types.name: High Potential Individual visa
types.purpose: Recent graduates of top world universities, no job offer needed.
types.who: Graduates of top global universities (last 5 years)

types.name: Scale-up Worker visa
types.purpose: A highly skilled job with a fast-growing UK business.
types.who: Workers with a job at an approved scale-up

types.name: Innovator Founder visa
types.purpose: Setting up an innovative, endorsed business in the UK.
types.who: Founders with an endorsed business idea

types.name: Youth Mobility Scheme visa
types.purpose: Live and work for up to 2 years — aged 18–30 (35 for some countries) from participating countries.
types.who: Ages 18–30 (35) from participating countries

types.name: Seasonal Worker visa
types.purpose: Seasonal horticulture or poultry work.
types.who: Seasonal farm workers via an approved operator
types.maxValidity: Up to 6 months (horticulture) or 2 Oct–31 Dec (poultry)
types.note: At most 6 months in any 12-month period.

types.name: Creative Worker visa
types.purpose: Short-term work in the creative industry: actors, musicians, dancers, film crew.
types.who: Creative workers with a sponsor

types.name: Charity Worker visa
types.purpose: Unpaid voluntary work for a licensed charity.
types.who: Volunteers sponsored by a licensed charity

types.name: Religious Worker visa
types.purpose: Temporary religious work, such as preaching or working in a religious order.
types.who: Religious workers with a sponsor

types.name: Minister of Religion visa
types.purpose: A job as a minister, missionary or member of a religious order.
types.who: Ministers of religion with a sponsor

types.name: Government Authorised Exchange visa
types.purpose: Work experience, training, research or fellowships through an approved exchange scheme.
types.who: Participants of an approved exchange scheme
types.maxValidity: Up to 12 or 24 months depending on the scheme

types.name: International Agreement visa
types.purpose: Work covered by international law: private servants of diplomats, employees of overseas governments or international organisations.
types.who: Staff covered by international agreements

types.name: Sportsperson visa
types.purpose: Elite sportspeople and qualified coaches.
types.who: Elite sportspeople and coaches
types.maxValidity: Up to 3 years (longer as a sponsored sportsperson)

types.name: Global Business Mobility visas
types.purpose: Moving to a UK branch of your employer: Senior or Specialist Worker, Graduate Trainee, UK Expansion Worker, Service Supplier, Secondment Worker.
types.who: Employees of an overseas company with a UK branch
types.maxValidity: Up to 1–5 years depending on the route

types.name: Overseas Domestic Worker visa
types.purpose: Domestic workers coming with their employer to a private household in the UK.
types.who: Domestic workers of visitors

types.name: Frontier Worker permit
types.purpose: EU, EEA or Swiss citizens living outside the UK who have worked in the UK since before 2021.
types.who: EU, EEA and Swiss citizens working in the UK since 2020

types.name: Family visa
types.purpose: Living with a partner, parent or child who is British, settled in the UK or has refugee status.
types.who: Partners, children and parents of UK residents
types.maxValidity: 2 years 9 months, extendable, leads to settlement

types.name: UK Ancestry visa
types.purpose: Commonwealth citizens with a grandparent born in the UK who want to work there.
types.who: Commonwealth citizens with a UK-born grandparent

types.name: British National (Overseas) visa
types.purpose: British Nationals (Overseas) from Hong Kong and their family.
types.who: British Nationals (Overseas) from Hong Kong

types.name: Indefinite leave to remain (settlement)
types.purpose: Living in the UK permanently after a qualifying period on another visa.
types.who: People with a qualifying period on another visa
types.note: No day count. Absences of more than 2 years can end your settled status.
